checks.title: Modular integration failures
checks.mitigation_summary: Define interfaces, semantic versioning, automated integration tests and CI/CD.
checks.acceptance_criteria: All modules pass integration tests in CI; breaking changes require version bump and migration guide.

checks.title: Scalability bottlenecks for simulations
checks.mitigation_summary: Employ horizontal scaling, async pipelines, and scheduled offline simulations.
checks.acceptance_criteria: System sustains target throughput in load tests with acceptable latency and predictable cost.

checks.title: Poor or inconsistent input data
checks.mitigation_summary: Enforce ingestion validators, required fields, and provenance capture.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Data validation failures < 1% for production ingest; provenance metadata present for each record.

checks.title: External data provider outages or schema changes
checks.mitigation_summary: Implement caching, multi-provider sourcing, and schema-change monitoring.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Graceful degradation path available; failover to cached/provider B demonstrated in tests.

checks.title: Model errors or brittle audits
checks.mitigation_summary: Model validation, holdout testing, adversarial checks, and human-in-loop for high-impact cases.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Models meet predefined performance thresholds on validation sets; human review enabled for top X% risk cases.

checks.title: Model drift
checks.mitigation_summary: Continuous monitoring and retraining pipelines with drift detection.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Drift detection alerts trigger retraining process and SLA for remediation.

checks.title: Insufficient explainability/audit trail
checks.mitigation_summary: Maintain immutable logs, feature-importance outputs, narrative rationales, and traceability to inputs.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Each decision includes an auditable trace linking inputs, model versions, feature attributions, and rationale.

checks.title: Jurisdictional regulatory non-compliance
checks.mitigation_summary: Legal reviews, configurable thresholds by jurisdiction, and manual escalation workflows.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Legal sign-off for supported jurisdictions; configuration tested per jurisdiction.

checks.title: Incorrect financial/stress-test calculations
checks.mitigation_summary: Peer review of financial-engineering code, reconciliation against authoritative spreadsheets.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Automated reconciliation tests pass; independent sign-off recorded.

checks.title: Security and data protection failures
checks.mitigation_summary: Encryption, RBAC, pen-tests, data-minimization, and DPIA.
checks.acceptance_criteria: No critical findings in pen-tests; compliance with applicable data protection laws.

checks.title: Secrets management or insider exposure
checks.mitigation_summary: Use secrets vaults, key rotation, and least-privilege IAM.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Secrets stored in vault; rotation policy enforced and audited.

checks.title: Partner integration mismatches
checks.mitigation_summary: Provide stable versioned APIs, adapters, and partner sandboxes.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Partner integration tests pass in sandbox; contract tests documented.

checks.title: Operational runbook and incident-response gaps
checks.mitigation_summary: Define runbooks, SLOs, on-call, and incident drills.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Runbooks published; tabletop drills executed with postmortems.

checks.title: Ethical and bias issues
checks.mitigation_summary: Bias testing, fairness constraints, and demographic impact assessment.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Bias assessments within tolerance; remediation implemented for identified issues.

checks.title: Vendor lock-in and third-party dependence
checks.mitigation_summary: Multi-cloud strategy, contractual exit clauses, and alternative-provider tests.
checks.acceptance_criteria: Failover to an alternative provider demonstrated in test plan.
